## Evidence
Attach a game-only image or a reviewed diagnostic report. Remove personal notes, browser tabs, bookmarks, local paths, or unrelated device information. Never attach access tokens or a browser profile.

## Test validity
For performance: include scene, resolution, feature settings, duration, and any warning shown by the benchmark. Do not treat an invalid run as a performance score.
